runtime_requirements: Run host CLI from the pinned audio.cpp checkout so current model_specs and bundled helper paths resolve. Phone binary needs AUDIOCPP_DEPLOYMENT_BUILD builtin contracts or an explicitly bundled full model_specs directory. SenseVoice default auto chunking also used bundled Silero weights at assets/framework/models/silero_vad. Host recipe validation is not Android runtime/package validation.

measurement_policy.asr: One fresh CLI process per item per primary recipe, 12 items; no excluded warmups; default modes retained; models executed sequentially in recipe order, not interleaved. Alternate streaming modes: two clips, one process each. All raw results retained.
measurement_policy.vad_turn: Five repetitions each of complete and incomplete clips, sequential model order. Process-cold, OS/file/materialization caches uncontrolled; repeat ranges retained.
measurement_policy.latency_clock: monotonic_ns receipt timestamps in Python; source log ts fields are only whole-second human timestamps. Native log timing values also retained. Streaming file inputs are unpaced.
measurement_policy.primary_rtf: post-load-to-final receipt time / input audio duration; process-including-load RTF separately. Neither is a microphone streaming latency measurement.
measurement_policy.wer: Corpus summed Levenshtein word edit distance / reference words. Lowercase ASCII alphanumerics, strip apostrophes, discard punctuation; no number expansion (five vs 5 counts).
measurement_policy.comparison_claim: Exploratory shortlist qualification, not statistical performance ranking or phone-real-time certification.

downloads.note: Sum of nine selected package payload sizes, all installed successfully; excludes already installed Smart Turn/LFM3/Kokoro, local copies of bundled VAD weights and generated WAVs. HTTP retry/metadata overhead is not measured.

catalog_inventory.description: Audio8-ASR-0.1B compact multilingual ASR (en/zh/yue/ja/ko/fr/de): Qwen3-ASR audio encoder with an MLP-tower adapter and an 8-layer Qwen2-style decoder. 30-second offline transcription windows. Checkpoint license: CC-BY-NC-4.0; GGUF conversion is local-only, no public redistribution is approved.
Audio Flamingo 3, Audio Flamingo Next, and Music Flamingo for transcription, captioning, and audio questions, with optional PEFT LoRA and SpotSound temporal grounding.
NVIDIA Canary multilingual speech recognition and speech translation.
NVIDIA CitriNet-family end-to-end English ASR model using a convolutional CTC architecture optimized for transcribing speech segments to text.
Cohere multilingual speech transcription with punctuation control.

NetEase Youdao Confucius4-R2T2 real-time ASR: a Qwen3-ASR fine-tune with Longest Stable Prefix (LSP) streaming. Low-latency append-only streaming from 80 ms to 2 s chunks, context and hotword prompts, 30 languages.
Whisper-based verbatim and intended speech transcription.
FireRedAudio native GGUF package for generation paths backed by a Qwen3.5 hybrid backbone, FireRed RedAE conditioning, RedPatchEncoder, RedDiT latent flow, and RedAE waveform decoding.
DFSMN speech activity detection with offline and causal Stream-VAD checkpoints.
Offline multilingual speech recognition with the FunAudioLLM Fun-ASR-Nano-2512 model.
GigaAM v3 and Multilingual Conformer speech recognition with CTC or RNN-T decoding.

IBM Granite Speech 5.0 TurboCTC 470M parameter Conformer CTC model. The current checkpoint transcribes English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, and Japanese with punctuation and capitalization. An older English-only checkpoint still loads.
Boson AI English speech-to-text model combining a Whisper Large v3 speech encoder with a Qwen decoder for robust ASR.
Danish-optimized Conformer encoder-decoder ASR model fine-tuned from the Hviske v5 family, with selectable Cohere ASR language prompts.
Danish speech recognition with a rotary Whisper encoder and Qwen3 decoder.
Index-Echo speech-to-text translation with bilingual timestamped subtitles.

Native Zipformer2 RNN-T transcription for the public free Kroko Community single-language packages, with offline and stateful streaming inference, greedy and modified beam decoding, hotwords, endpoint segments, partial results, and word timestamps.

Liquid AI's LFM2.5-Audio, loaded from the llama.cpp-format GGUF components Liquid publishes. ASR: a FastConformer encoder feeds an LFM2 hybrid short-conv/attention backbone. TTS: the backbone generates audio frames through a depthformer, and an LFM2 detokenizer and ISTFT turn them into 24 kHz audio. S2S: a spoken question goes in as for ASR, and the reply comes out as interleaved text and audio.

Liquid AI's LFM3-Audio-2B, from the llama.cpp-format GGUFs Liquid publishes or the upstream safetensors directory. ASR: a log-mel LFM2 encoder feeds an LFM3 hybrid conv/attention backbone. TTS: the backbone drives a bidirectional MaskGIT depth decoder (12 codebooks, 12.5 Hz) and the LiquidCodec decoder and ISTFT give 24 kHz audio. S2S: a spoken question in, interleaved text and audio out, with client-held multi-turn history.
Whisper audio encoder and hybrid KDA/MLA mixture-of-experts Thinker, with a separate continuous-latent Talker for spoken responses.
Moonshine tiny/small/medium streaming English speech recognition models.
Joint transcription, speaker diarization, and timestamps across 50+ languages with a Whisper encoder and Qwen3 decoder.

NVIDIA 600M streaming ASR model for low-latency and batch transcription across 40 language-locales, with native punctuation, capitalization, automatic language detection, and configurable chunk sizes.
Experimental community port of the Nemotron-H speech language model for offline transcription, translation, audio questions, language identification, word timestamps and speaker labels.
ABR Niagara English batch ASR state-space models with attention, greedy CTC decoding, and SentencePiece tokenization.
ESPnet Open Whisper-style multilingual speech recognition and speech translation.
ESPnet non-autoregressive multilingual speech recognition and speech translation with self-conditioned CTC.

NVIDIA Parakeet-TDT 0.6B v3 FastConformer-TDT ASR covering 25 European languages with automatic language detection. Supports the upstream Transformers-compatible safetensors package and standalone audio.cpp GGUF, with offline full-context, bounded-window long-form, and buffered streaming; the checkpoint uses unlimited bidirectional attention and is not a native cache-aware streaming model.
Speech activity detection for 16 kHz mono audio with 2.1K student and 81K teacher weights.

Qwen ASR model family for language identification and speech recognition across 30 languages, 22 Chinese dialects, and multiple English accents, with robustness for noisy, long-form, and singing audio.
Compact audio-language models for audio captioning, question answering, and sound, music, and speech understanding.
SenseVoice-Small multilingual speech recognition with rich event/emotion/ITN tags via a SAN-M encoder and CTC head, ported to audio.cpp.
Audio-native conversational turn-completion detection using a Whisper-Tiny encoder and attention-pooling classifier.
VibeASR.cpp's CPU-first VibeVoice ASR port: an INT8 (I8_S) audio VAE encoder feeding a ternary (I2_S) Qwen2 decoder, ported to audio.cpp.

Microsoft long-form speech-to-text model that processes up to 60 minutes of audio in one pass and produces structured transcripts with speakers, timestamps, content, hotwords, and 50+ language support.
Microsoft VibeVoice ASR Streaming models (7B and 1.5B) for chunked streaming speech-to-text with persistent decoder state.
Mistral 13-language realtime ASR model with a natively streaming causal audio encoder, configurable low-latency transcription delay, and accuracy competitive with offline open-source systems.
Whistle offline speech recognition with FP32 GGUF weights, a GGML encoder and a host decoder.
